body: Disposition request: BUG-1187 (draft, high) — aida session reap / aida awaiting report 230 false 'unshipped work' items. Verified mechanism in collect_unshipped_work_items: (1) the status exclusion is built from the default OPEN lens so Completed specs are never in the map; (2) only OPEN PRs exclude a branch, MERGED (squash) PRs do not, pr_state is hardcoded absent; (3) commits-ahead is raw rev-list, not the existing patch-equivalence helper. Every sampled item (PR-1877, PR-1746, PR-100; TASK-330/101, BUG-231, TASK-1205) is already merged/Completed. Linked to TASK-1222 (the cruft sweep is cleanup; this is the detector). Drain-safe if you approve+queue it. Also: #1888 (docs, plan-lint) is CLEAN and ready to ship.
